title: The $*$-algebra of unbounded GLT: construction and theoretical foundations
summary: In the present paper, we are concerned with the study of matrix-sequences arising from the discretization of PDEs and FDEs on domains $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ with finite measure. When $Ω$ is either a hypercube or a bounded domain, the theory of Generalized Locally Toeplitz (GLT) sequences and of reduced GLT sequences cover the spectral analysis of the matrix-sequences derived from the approximation of the continuous problem.
